newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean, HRW wheat basis weakens.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean, HRW wheat basis weakens.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean and hard red winter wheat basis values were down from Tuesday, while corn and soft red winter basis values were mostly unchanged, grain dealers said.

An increased flow of soybeans into market channels after Wednesday's sharp gains in CBOT soybean futures prompted exporters to lower FOB offers. One dealer said the soybean supply increased but export demand remained light.
Poor export demand for hard red winter wheat pressured those values.
